statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail is low because NQ is in the regular weekend closure and no live one-way price path can be observed; Stress remains extreme from rate repricing, energy disruption and geopolitical risk.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: EA_ON; Tail remains below the block threshold, while extreme Stress reflects the strong-labor/high-yield backdrop and conditional weekend reopening risk.
headline: Weekend closure keeps Tail low while rates and geopolitical Stress remain extreme
body: Nasdaq futures are closed, so no current continuation, shallow-pullback or failed-retracement path can be verified. Friday's 162,000 payroll gain lifted rate-hike expectations and yields; mixed tech leadership limits directional confirmation, while Hormuz disruption and Iran-related escalation keep reopening-gap risk material.

lookbackSummary: The prior 24 hours covered Friday's payroll-driven repricing and the transition into the weekend closure. Published Tail spent most hours in WATCH or low, with two brief elevated orange states when downside structure strengthened; it returned to low once the session ended and live path evidence disappeared.
outlookSummary: Across the next 24 hours NQ remains in its scheduled weekend closure, so Tail stays low unless a verified geopolitical discontinuity materially changes reopening risk. Stress remains extreme because strong labor data, elevated yields and Gulf energy disruption persist; confidence gradually declines as Friday's tradable evidence ages.
